name: Witheroak-Tipped Ritual Arrows
description: Ritual arrows with heads worked from Witheroak — used only for specific druidic and Heartwarden ceremonial purposes during Feywood strain, not for combat.
narrative_effects: Ritual-use only; loosing these arrows in ordinary combat is a significant transgression elves would remark on.
Each arrow's provenance is known to the druid who sanctioned its material; non-elves do not receive these through ordinary trade.
